info.title: Galaxy Sports Edge — Proof API
info.summary: Read-only endpoints for independently auditing the publish-before-kickoff pick record.
info.description: Public, no-auth endpoints an agent uses to read and independently verify the record. The ledger surfaces are founder-gated (they report an honest unpublished state until a substantiated record exists) and can only ever carry metrics that cleared a four-leg substantiation guard. Receipt endpoints expose only settled, kicked-off commitments, each carrying the leaf preimage so the SHA-256 hash can be recomputed and checked against the frozen commitment.

get.description: The founder-gated ledger state (published:false with a reason until PUBLISH_LEDGER is set) plus the doctrine, verification links, and hard refusals. Always 200.

get.summary: Enumerable list of settled, individually-verifiable pick receipts.
get.description: Lists only settled AND kicked-off receipts (a strict subset of 'open'), so a pre-kickoff commitment never appears. Each row carries the leaf preimage for independent recomputation.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque receipt id from a prior page's nextCursor.

200.description: A page of settled receipts (empty list when none exist yet).

503.description: The proof ledger is temporarily unavailable (DB outage). Not a verdict of non-existence.

get.summary: Trustless conformance spec: the hash-chain algorithm + known-answer test vectors.
get.description: The exact pick-commitment algorithm plus synthetic KAT vectors, so a third party can implement the verifier in any language and confirm it reproduces our hashes. No auth, always 200.

200.description: The verification specification and its test vectors.

get.summary: Verify a single pick receipt by its content hash.
get.description: Re-hashes the stored payload and compares it to the frozen commitment. Pre-kickoff receipts return a SEALED result (existence + integrity + freeze time only); post-kickoff/settled receipts open in full.

200.description: Verification result (found:false, sealed, or fully opened).

503.description: The verifier is temporarily unavailable. Not a verdict.

MachineProofDoc.description: The proof snapshot. See /llms.txt for the human-oriented manifest.

ledger.description: Founder-gated ledger view: unpublished (with a reason) or published with substantiated rows.

verified.description: Server-side tamper check: hash intact AND columns match the hashed payload.

committed.description: Committed fields, present only when verified is true.
